messages:
mike: FYI nightly gpu CI on h100 pool is red for quantized-inference-tests, looks like a kernel timeout/XID event on step 42. attaching the failing log snippet.

ci-bot: job https://ci.redwood.ai/rd/12345 failed (h100-nightly, quantized-inference). rerun button available.

sara: thanks, mike. can you paste the XID and any driver/cuda info from the node? wondering if this is the old driver flip regression. :eyes:

mike: node metadata: kernel 6.1, driver 535.86, cuda 12.2. XID: 45 (gpu hung). log: ```
[2026-03-16T03:21:12Z] nvml: GPU 0: Xid 45: GPU page fault or hang
[2026-03-16T03:21:12Z] runtime: kernel timeout detected, aborting kernel launch seq=0x7f8a
[2026-03-16T03:21:12Z] stacktrace: ...
```

jess: odd, the dedicated-nightly runs use driver 535.54 in staging. could be a driver minor bump. i can spin up a debug rerun pinned to 535.54 if we want to check.

alex: quick triage: is this consistently reproducing on reruns or flaky? mike, did you try a rerun?

mike: I clicked rerun via the CI UI, first rerun failed again with same XID after ~18s. second rerun passed. flaky.

sara: sounds flaky. can we bisect to find the commit range? if it's hardware-level maybe bisect won't help, but we should narrow down if a code change triggered more kernel stress.

jess: @infra-bot can you schedule a controlled rerun matrix: (1) driver=535.86 + cuda=12.2 (current), (2) driver=535.54 + cuda=12.2, (3) driver=535.86 + cuda=12.1 ? include run with DEBUG_ENV=INFERENCE_VERBOSE=1 and LOG_LEVEL=debug.

infra-bot: scheduled: https://ci.redwood.ai/rd/matrix/67890 entries created. will pin images and collect sysinfo artifacts. ETA ~35m.

alex: while we wait: mike, can you paste the failing test name and the short pynoise stack? might help see if it's memory-corruptiony or a long kernel.

mike: failing test: tests/inference/test_quantized_attention.py::test_long_context_decode. stack: ```
RuntimeError: kernel abort: launch failed
 at /root/repo/ops/attn.cu:line 314
```

sara: ok looks like the long sequence path triggers a heavy attention kernel. likely sensitive to scheduling. if infra matrix shows driver-dependent rate, we escalate to driver folks and maybe add a soft timeout fallback to CPU for that test temporarily.

jess: I'll open a quick PR that adds a retry & collects more kernel dumps for this test. tagging @mike to review. PR will also mark the test flaky in nightly to prevent noisy alerts.

mike: SGTM. i'll review and also try to repro locally with a small loop on h100-emu image.

ci-bot: matrix jobs started: 3 jobs queued. artifacts will be uploaded to https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/67890 once finished. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: thanks all. if the matrix indicates driver 535.86 is the culprit we'll open a driver-issue ticket and coordinate rollback or pin in staging. otherwise, follow up in this thread with results. :thumbsup:
